name: Marcellus
source: A fellow patient in the Ward. Deeply dislikes Manson for his antics and wants nothing to do with him. Marcellus suffers from anger issues, specifically Intermittent Explosive Disorder, exacerbated by his gambling addition. [Spoiler]Despite him being abrasive towards Manson and Kent's sexuality, Marcellus is in a relationship with [url=https://vndb.org/c150920]Heiko[/url].[/spoiler]
